notes.title: Unavowed Patch v2.0.0
notes.notes:
-Added global settings
-Added advance text option [on means text advances by default or on a key/mouse press, off means it advances only by user input]

notes.title: Unavowed - Engine Patch
notes.notes:
Hi,

We're upgrading the game to 3.6 version of AGS, which basically means better rendering, better support for resolutions and better support for keyboard and mouse!

The savegames have been tested and should work, and shouldn't break.
If for any reason there's an issue, feel free to report and opt in to beta oldversion, by using the password "oldversionold"

notes.title: Remember your Name - Small patch.
notes.notes:
Basically, for all the builds two things are done.

1) Every builds now features the same version number [that should be 1.0.2]
2) More importantly, you can now name your character "Eliza, Elisabeth, Felicity, Belinda". Unless your name is "Eli" or "eli" the game will now allow you to contain 'eli'.
